steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Set the event type to RFQ as required by the scenario.
Provide the mandatory event title before continuing.
Apply the first RFQ template so the product sheet is available.
Add the requested CYLINDER line item with quantity 10.

args.goal: On the single-stage RFQ create screen, select CYLINDER WITH KEY & KNOB for the first Product cell so Product Variant shows Default Variant, set Delivery location to Plant Name (LOC-0001), enter QA clause in Add your own terms & conditions, add it, press Done, and stop with QA clause visibly listed in the terms and conditions section

steps.note: Perform and verify the product variant, delivery location, and custom clause interactions that have no dedicated catalog step.
Commit a valid event schedule so the RFQ can be published.
Invite one QA test vendor to verify vendor visibility.
Confirm the event reached a published project page.
Open the invited vendor's supplier-portal session.
Open the event overview where vendor-facing terms are available.
Verify the vendor can see the custom clause.
